question: Sammakka Saralamma Jatara is celebrated in which of the following states of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Telangana**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sammakka Saralamma Jatara **is a Hindu tribal deity festival observed in the** Indian state of Telangana**.
 
• This Jatara is famous for hosting one of the** world's biggest gatherings of people.**
 
• People offer **Bangaram: The Jatara starts in Medaram, Tadvai Mandala,** Mulugu district.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb4bb90e631d514bf34bb3c7f50fbaaa613471e1138e8d221a9ffa08efbfe67f.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Saralamma Sammakka Jathara **recalls the battle of a mother and daughter, Sammakka and Saralamma, against an unfair legislation with the governing monarchs.
 
• After Kumbha Mela, it is thought that** Medaram Jathara** gets the greatest number of worshippers in the country.
 
• It is celebrated in** Medaram **during a period when indigenous goddesses are said to visit them.
